summary: uri options: HTTP method (default GET, any valid method) and mode for downloaded files.
questions: How do I send a PUT or DELETE request with uri?
What method does uri use by default?

answer_card.title: uri method and mode
answer_card.answer_md:
- `method` (GET): any method the service accepts (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH...)
- `mode`: for `dest` file
